paperl10n-empty-state: Open a project folder to see what there is to translate.
paperl10n-error-workspace-config-missing: This folder has no paperl10n.config.json yet.
paperl10n-error-workspace-config-unreada: The config file $1 can't be read ($2).
paperl10n-error-workspace-unknown-docume: The config names the format "$1", which isn't installed.
paperl10n-error-workspace-no-document-fo: No installed format recognizes this project. Name one in the config file with "documentFormat".
paperl10n-error-workspace-unknown-projec: That project isn't open anymore. Open it again.
paperl10n-error-internal-unexpected: Something went wrong inside Paper Lion. Please report it.
paperl10n-error-internal-invalid-request: Paper Lion received a request it can't handle. Please report it.
paperl10n-welcome-title: Translate your docs, side by side
paperl10n-error-workspace-unknown-docume: The page "$1" isn't in this project anymore. Open the project again to refresh the list.
paperl10n-error-workspace-no-target-loca: Choose the language to translate into first.
paperl10n-error-workspace-unknown-langua: Paper Lion doesn't know the language "$1". To use it, define it under "languages" in paperl10n.config.json.
paperl10n-error-workspace-target-is-sour: "$1" is this project's source language, so the translation can't be in it too.
paperl10n-needs-target: This project has no translation language yet. Until the language picker arrives, add "targetLocale" to paperl10n.config.json and open the project again.
paperl10n-error-workspace-config-unwrita: The config file $1 can't be saved ($2).
